# Watchfront

> Website monitoring and automated QA for agencies in India.

Watchfront monitors uptime, SSL, domain expiry, content, visual changes, JavaScript errors, APIs, and lead forms across every client website — then turns incidents into evidence and client-ready reports.

Website: https://watchfront.in
Pricing: https://watchfront.in/pricing
Features: https://watchfront.in/features
Contact: https://watchfront.in/contact
Start free: https://watchfront.in/register

## Primary product pages

- [Uptime monitoring](https://watchfront.in/features/uptime-monitoring): 1-minute checks, retries, confirmed-outage email alerts
- [SSL & domain expiry](https://watchfront.in/features/ssl-domain-monitoring): certificate and registry expiry warnings
- [Visual & content checks](https://watchfront.in/features/visual-regression-testing): missing text, broken links, screenshot baselines
- [Form & journey testing](https://watchfront.in/features/form-journey-testing): Playwright journeys for contact forms and bookings
- [API monitoring](https://watchfront.in/features/api-monitoring): scheduled endpoint checks with assertions
- [JavaScript error monitoring](https://watchfront.in/features/javascript-error-monitoring): real-visitor errors grouped by fingerprint
- [Client reports](https://watchfront.in/features/client-reports): shareable uptime and incident reports

## Who it is for

- [Web agencies](https://watchfront.in/use-cases/web-agencies)
- [WordPress maintenance](https://watchfront.in/use-cases/wordpress-maintenance)
- [Marketing agencies](https://watchfront.in/use-cases/marketing-agencies)
- [Freelance developers](https://watchfront.in/use-cases/freelancers)

## Pricing (INR via Cashfree)

- Free: up to 3 websites
- Starter: ₹999/mo (1–3 websites)
- Growth: ₹2,499/mo (4–10 websites)
- Agency: ₹4,999/mo (up to 50 websites)
